# Entrain Labs

> Entrain Labs is a digital marketing academy based in Kerala, India, offering training courses in digital marketing.

Website: https://entrainlabs.in/

## Main pages

- [Home](https://entrainlabs.in/): Overview of the academy and its programs.
- [Courses](https://entrainlabs.in/courses): Digital marketing courses offered by Entrain Labs.
- [Offline Batches](https://entrainlabs.in/offline-batches): Offline classroom training batches in Kerala.
- [Online Plans](https://entrainlabs.in/online-plans): Online training programs and pricing plans.
- [About](https://entrainlabs.in/about): About the academy.
- [Blog](https://entrainlabs.in/blog): Articles and insights on digital marketing.
- [Contact](https://entrainlabs.in/contact): Enquiries and admissions contact.
